scope: All four original full-resolution PNG paths and matching marketing.webp per assigned ID were individually inspected with vision_analyze. No boards used. Parent visual-group-1.json was read after image inspection to preserve substantive holds. Source commit provenance is supplied context, not independently rehashed in this review.
limitations: Static endpoints do not prove mechanism function, hinge attachment, latch engagement, collision-free motion, controls or physical-phone performance.
No promotional open-state reference was supplied. Hidden exterior ornament in open views is not evidence it is missing.
Visible seams and exposed released latch tabs are not by themselves defects. No approvals or art changes are authorized by this report.
Mobile supporting copy is small across the set; screenshots show no obvious horizontal overflow or cropped model. Accessibility compliance was not measured.

reviews.appearance: Wide pale mottled chest with block feet, turquoise inset and seam, shallow pink C-shaped shore, thick upright pale arch and long gold clasp. Marketing preserves these same major forms; it does not show a naturalistic eroded coastal arch that the model has omitted.

state_observations.desktop-closed: Entire chest visible. Arch curve and pink band have angular transitions; broad ivory faces show subtle cloudy mottling. Gold corner caps and clasp remain readable.
state_observations.desktop-open: Entire raised lid and projecting released tab fit. Pale empty cavity, turquoise rim, plain pale lid underside and two rear hinge pieces visible; deeper floor partly occluded by front wall.
state_observations.mobile-closed: Arch, pink shore and turquoise panel remain distinguishable. Complete object and controls fit; small details become faceted and less crisp.
state_observations.mobile-open: Complete open silhouette and pale cavity remain readable. Abrupt pale-corner/turquoise-rim joins and slight edge stair-stepping visible; no definite penetration.

uncertain_inspection_points: Open hinge mounting surfaces are partly hidden; separation at the rear cannot establish detached hardware.
artistic_gaps: Water reads as opaque colored inlay, pink shore as a smooth raised ribbon and arch as a sculptural handle-like form.
Marketing has richer contact shadows, smoother edge treatment and more convincing gold highlights; this is principally finish rather than changed silhouette.
reviews.parent_hold_disposition: Preserve disclosed abstract-coastal and promotional-finish limitations. No substantive parent needs-decision hold was present for this ID.
reviews.suggested_next_step: Present as a stylized candidate with explicit material/finish limitations; do not advertise photographic coastal or promotional-render parity.

reviews.appearance: Ivory rectangular coastal chest with gold clasp, round front fitting, side ring, pale sculpted feet, turquoise inset, raised pale-pink banks and a small dark oval blue-hole motif. Broad composition matches marketing.

state_observations.desktop-closed: Complete box visible. Pink terrain and feet look faceted; blue hole reads as a dark flat oval rather than perceptibly deep water. Teal lid/body seam is conspicuous.
state_observations.desktop-open: Empty pale cavity, plain ivory lid underside, two rear hinges, front fittings and left ring are visible and entirely framed.
state_observations.mobile-closed: Turquoise coastal palette remains legible, but feet, banks and small fittings soften into ambiguous low-detail forms. Blue-hole depth is especially weak. No cropping.
state_observations.mobile-open: Open cavity and complete lid/tab/feet fit. Pale corner blocks interrupt teal rim; hinge connection is visually discontinuous at this scale but not proven detached.

uncertain_inspection_points: Closed teal seam can resemble a gap, but the marketing also carries a turquoise seam; no failed closure can be concluded.
Rear hinge attachment cannot be resolved from the endpoint perspective.
artistic_gaps: Blue hole reads as a dark oval in the viewer versus a lighter, more shaded basin-like mark in marketing; image evidence does not prove missing depression geometry.
Body material is generic matte ivory rather than strongly tactile limestone; water is enamel-like and banks/feet are angular.
Marketing has softer sculptural shading and stronger grounding, not a fundamentally different chest shape.
reviews.parent_hold_disposition: Preserve blue-hole depth, opaque water, irregular-bank and material-polish limitations; do not reinterpret the shared teal seam as demonstrated malfunction.
reviews.suggested_next_step: Present as a stylized coastal candidate, explicitly disclosing shallow visual depth and nonrealistic water.

reviews.appearance: Cream paneled chest outlined in muted red, brown grained timber lid, small turquoise border accents, gold front clasp and pale stone-like feet. A raised pale faceted mountain rises from a rectangular lid inset.

state_observations.desktop-closed: Entire box visible. Mountain is a few broad angular planes with a dominant peak; tiny turquoise details and projecting red corner blocks are somewhat abrupt.
state_observations.desktop-open: Brown timber lid underside and empty wood-lined cavity visible. Complete lid/tab and feet fit; dark separation near rear hinges warrants caution, not a detachment claim.
state_observations.mobile-closed: Cream/red architecture and mountain silhouette survive. Fine cornice accents lose definition; no clipped object or text overlap.
state_observations.mobile-open: Brown empty cavity and plain wood underside read clearly; red caps project beyond rim, with blocky joins. No obvious major hole, missing face or viewport clipping.

uncertain_inspection_points: Rear hinge/body connection is not fully resolved; pictures cannot demonstrate its mechanics.
artistic_gaps: Marketing mountain has rugged multi-ridge craggy surface relief; viewer mountain has broad smooth facets. This is a substantive form/detail expectation gap, not merely warmer lighting.
Marketing cream panels look woven and brown lid edging looks stitched/leather-like; viewer panels read plaster-like and lid edging as regularly grained timber. Perceived material language differs.
Basic paneled chest, inset mountain location and hardware remain recognizable; mismatch is not evidence of a rendering failure.
reviews.parent_hold_disposition: Preserved parent needs-decision hold for mountain relief and panel/lid material mismatch; not downgraded to an ordinary lighting-only caveat.
reviews.suggested_next_step: User must choose whether to retain the stylized plaster/timber and faceted-mountain direction with aligned marketing, or authorize a separate fidelity revision. This report approves neither.

reviews.appearance: Cream woven-looking panels with charcoal and terracotta diamond bands, brown frame and block feet, raised concentric lid coil, brass clasp, round front fitting and left ring. Marketing retains the same chest and ornamental layout.

state_observations.desktop-closed: Entire model visible; lid coil has dimensional ridges and panels have fine surface pattern. A small irregular dark mark near the side panel edge is ambiguous, not a confirmed texture failure.
state_observations.desktop-open: Plain brown lid underside, empty brown cavity, two rear hinges and principal front/side fittings are readable and fully framed.
state_observations.mobile-closed: Diamond motif and concentric coil survive; fine woven texture flattens and small hardware/coil edges alias. Complete chest and page controls fit.
state_observations.mobile-open: Empty brown cavity and lid fit with all visible fittings. Rim transitions and patterned edges look coarse; no definite mesh penetration or cropping.

uncertain_inspection_points: Small side-panel dark mark could be ornament, shadow or seam; it is insufficient evidence for a broken UV or missing-map claim.
artistic_gaps: Fine fiber/weave detail is weak at mobile scale; appearance is a procedural craft interpretation rather than literal woven construction.
Marketing frame is more tactile and hardware shading richer; actual frame/interior are smoother and more matte. Main geometry and motifs are preserved.
reviews.parent_hold_disposition: Retain fiber-detail and promotional-finish limitations. Left-side ring is visibly present; do not resurrect a missing-hardware allegation from a reduced board.
reviews.suggested_next_step: Present as a stylized craft-inspired candidate with clear limits on fiber realism and no artisan-authenticity claim.

reviews.appearance: Bright red rectangular chest with dark block feet, gold clasp/caps, round front fitting and side ring. Three raised rounded flower clusters on the lid and paired angular diamond groups on the front carry the floral identity.

state_observations.desktop-closed: Complete model visible; flowers are thick rounded rosettes and surface shows broad horizontal tonal bands. Pronounced dark lid seam also occurs in marketing.
state_observations.desktop-open: Dark burgundy empty cavity, thin contrasting rim, plain red inner lid and two rear hinge pieces visible. Complete lid/tab/feet remain framed; cavity floor partially occluded.
state_observations.mobile-closed: Strong red/gold contrast and floral clusters remain legible, but petals are bead-like and tiny stems/leaves indistinct. No viewport clipping.
state_observations.mobile-open: Banded red lid underside and burgundy cavity remain visible. Angular front lozenges and abrupt corner/rim joins are evident, without definite intersection or missing geometry.

uncertain_inspection_points: Dark seam and small apparent hinge gaps do not prove failed closure or detached components.
Reduced visibility of stems/leaves is not proof their meshes are absent.
artistic_gaps: Marketing flowers have more distinctly articulated centers, connecting stems and leaf accents; viewer florals read as simplified bulbous clusters. This is a meaningful ornamental readability gap.
Marketing is deeper red with finer irregular wood-like surface variation and a darker top inset. Viewer is brighter vermilion with broader, more regular banding, conspicuous on the open underside.
Hardware is flatter/yellower in the viewer. Lighting alone does not account for all relief/readability and pattern differences.
reviews.parent_hold_disposition: Preserved parent needs-decision hold for floral/lacquer fidelity. No claim that historical petal-seating issues persist in these stills.
reviews.suggested_next_step: Ask the user to decide between retaining the simplified floral/material direction with aligned marketing and a separately authorized fidelity revision; do not claim promotional parity.
